name: dense_city_sweep_100m_hwrt_high
title: Dense City sweep at 100M instanced triangles, NextGI High: G5-9's whole frame, report-only

lines.name: Dense City sweep, 100M instanced triangles, whole frame
lines.reason: G5-9 is report-only with the UE ratio (plan §23.6); the sweep runs the G5-1 set's settings. GodotNext's virtual shadow maps are not built yet (the engine has no shadow_method setting), so its side renders the scene's shadows on the shadow atlas (the sun's 4 directional splits and the street lights' shadow faces) while UE renders Virtual Shadow Maps, the comparison project's shadow method (r.Shadow.Virtual.Enable, which the report checks from each run's echo); the line is not like for like until GodotNext's virtual shadow maps land. UE also runs distance-field shadows (GPU/DistanceFieldShadows is busy in these captures). The settings record's far-shadow row says they are on by default for directional lights, shadow what lies beyond the dynamic shadow distance and work in tandem with Virtual Shadow Maps; GodotNext has not built them yet. UE takes the hardware tier from r.Lumen.HardwareRayTracing 1 at launch, because the shared comparison project keeps Use Hardware Ray Tracing when available off. This departs from the settings record and plan §23.5, which say the comparison enables the two project settings, until the lead decides.
